facts.fact: Zambia Monitor reports the Zambia Bureau of Standards (ZABS), described as a national standards body, signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Rwanda Standards Board on standardisation, conformity assessment and quality assurance at the 32nd ARSO General Assembly in Mombasa; the report names no IT or data standard and does not say how ZABS was established.

systems.owner: Government of Zambia (Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry named as the technical-regulations ministry)
